segments.name: Enterprise Talent Management
segments.description: Provides temporary staffing, outcome-based and permanent placement services in light industrial, contact center and office clerical specialties, plus global MSP, RPO and PPO solutions.
segments.evidence: Enterprise Talent Management – delivers temporary staffing, outcome-based and permanent placement services focused on light industrial, contact center and office and clerical specialties in North America across a variety of industries and includes products such as Business Process Outsourcing, KellyConnect and Skilled Professional Solutions offerings.

segments.name: Science, Engineering & Technology
segments.description: Provides highly specialized temporary staffing, outcome-based and permanent placement services in science, clinical research, engineering, technology and telecommunications.
segments.evidence: SET is focused on science and clinical research, engineering, technology and telecommunications specialties predominantly in North America.

segments.name: Education
segments.evidence: Education – delivers high quality education and therapy services talent through temporary staffing, permanent placement and executive search services to Pre-K-12 school districts and education organizations across the U.S.

changes.text: In 2025, Kelly combined its former P&I and OCG segments into the new Enterprise Talent Management segment.
changes.evidence: We combined our former P&I and OCG segments into the ETM segment in the first quarter of 2025, responding to a shift in customer demand toward integrated workforce solutions and enabling a more streamlined and efficient go-to-market approach.

changes.text: In 2024, Kelly completed the sale of its European staffing operations within the International business unit.
changes.evidence: In 2024, Kelly completed the sale of its European staffing operations within the Company's International business unit, further sharpening its focus on specialty outcome-based and staffing services in North America, while maintaining global recruitment process outsourcing ("RPO") and MSP capabilities.

changes.text: In 2022, Kelly monetized its non-core stake in Persol Holdings.
changes.evidence: By monetizing non-core assets (Persol Holdings Co., Ltd. in 2022 and EMEA staffing operations in 2024, among other transactions) and redeploying available capital, Kelly completed several strategic acquisitions over the years.
